arxiv-2304-00271.title: SCALAR CURVATURE OPERATOR FOR LOOP QUANTUM GRAVITY ON A CUBICAL GRAPH Thanks: Presented at the 8 th Conference of the Polish Society on Relativity, Warsaw, Poland, 19–23 September 2022.
arxiv-2304-00271.creator: Ilkka Mäkinen
arxiv-2304-00271.description: Abstract We introduce a new operator representing the three-dimensional scalar curvature in loop quantum gravity. The operator is constructed by writing the Ricci scalar classically as a function of the Ashtekar variables and regularizing the resulting expression on a cubical spin network graph.

arxiv-2411-11816.title: Noncommutative Gelfand Duality: the algebraic case
arxiv-2411-11816.description: Abstract The goal of this paper is to define a notion of non-commutative Gelfand duality . Using techniques from derived algebraic geometry, we show that the category of rings is anti-equivalent to a subcategory of pre-ringed sites, inspired by Grothendieck’s work on commutative rings. Our notion of spectrum, although formally reminiscent of the Grothendieck spectrum, is new .

arxiv-2502-14375.title: VFL-RPS: Relevant Participant Selection in Vertical Federated Learning
arxiv-2502-14375.creator: 1 st Afsana Khan, 2 nd Marijn ten Thij, 3 rd Guangzhi Tang, 3 rd Anna Wilbik
arxiv-2502-14375.description: Abstract Federated Learning (FL) allows collaboration between different parties, while ensuring that the data across these parties is not shared. However, not every collaboration is helpful in terms of the resulting model performance. Therefore, it is an important challenge to select the correct participants in a collaboration.

pmc-10513345.title: Spatial-temporal differences and influencing factors of coupling coordination between urban quality and technology innovation in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
pmc-10513345.creator: Zhichen Yang, Yuxi Wu, Fangfang Wang, Aichun Chen, Yixuan Wang, Shi Yin, Shi Yin, Shi Yin, C. A. Zúniga-González, C. A. Zúniga-González
pmc-10513345.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The coordinated development of urban quality and technology innovation is an important element of China’s technology innovation development strategy in the new era. Based on entropy TOPSIS, coupling coordination models, the gravity center and standard deviation ellipse method, the geographic probe, the GWR, and other methods, we explore the spatial variation and influencing factors of the coupling coordination relationship between urban quality and technology innovation in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area from 2011 to 2020.

pmc-10531411.title: The MothersBabies Study, an Australian Prospective Cohort Study Analyzing the Microbiome in the Preconception and Perinatal Period to Determine Risk of Adverse Pregnancy, Postpartum, and Child-Related Health Outcomes: Study Protocol
pmc-10531411.creator: Naomi Strout, Lana Pasic, Chloe Hicks, Xin-Yi Chua, Niki Tashvighi, Phoebe Butler, Zhixin Liu, Fatima El-Assaad, Elaine Holmes, Daniella Susic, Katherine Samaras, Maria E Craig, Gregory K Davis, Amanda Henry, William L Ledger, Emad M El-Omar, Amanda Rodrigues Amorim Adegboye, Kim Bul, Dayana Rodrigu
pmc-10531411.description: The microbiome has emerged as a key determinant of human health and reproduction, with recent evidence suggesting a dysbiotic microbiome is implicated in adverse perinatal health outcomes. The existing research has been limited by the sample collection and timing, cohort design, sample design, and lack of data on the preconception microbiome.

pmc-11468235.title: Degree of food processing and breast cancer risk: a prospective study in 9 European countries
pmc-11468235.creator: Manon Cairat, Sahar Yammine, Thibault Fiolet, Agnès Fournier, Marie-Christine Boutron-Ruault, Nasser Laouali, Francesca Romana Mancini, Gianluca Severi, Fernanda Morales Berstein, Fernanda Rauber, Renata Bertazzi Levy, Guri Skeie, Kristin Benjaminsen Borch, Anne Tjønneland, Lene Mellemkjær, Yan Born
pmc-11468235.description: Recent epidemiological studies have suggested a positive association between ultra-processed food consumption and breast cancer risk, although some studies also reported no association. Furthermore, the evidence regarding the associations between intake of food with lower degrees of processing and breast cancer risk is limited.

pmc-11690560.title: EXPLORING END-OF-LIFE DEMENTIA CARE IN RESIDENTIAL CARE SETTINGS: TOWARD A RELATIONAL MODEL
pmc-11690560.creator: Pia Kontos, Sherry Dupuis, Romeo Colobong, Erin Delaney, Robin Gertin, Katia Engell, Erica MacTavish
pmc-11690560.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). With the biomedicalization of death in Canada, and the stigma associated with both dementia and death, people living with dementia (PLwD) in Canada suffer painful and undignified end-of-life (EOL) experiences. There is growing evidence that relational approaches, which value relationships as complex and dynamic connections including broader social, cultural, political, and environmental forces, can reduce stigma and improve quality of care. Yet, these approaches have not been explored or implemented in EOL care.

pmc-12371015.title: Microscopic assessment of lymph node status in gynecological malignancies using full-field optical coherence tomography
pmc-12371015.creator: Matteo Pavone, Laetitia Rebiere, Lise Lecointre, Emma Carles, Clément Tondon, Pauline Le Van Quyen, Barbara Seeliger, Diana Giannarelli, Thomas Lampert, Nicolò Bizzarri, Giovanni Scambia, Cherif Akladios, Alina Nicolae, Denis Querleu, Aïna Venkatasamy
pmc-12371015.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Accurate assessment of lymph node (LN) status is critical in cancer management, particularly in gynecological malignancies. However, preoperative identification of pathological LNs remains a significant challenge with current imaging modalities. Full-field optical coherence tomography (FF-OCT) is a non-invasive microscopic technique based on tissue reflectivity and light interference, providing real-time, high-resolution images in < 10 min, with no tissue preparation or alteration required.

pmc-13378376.title: The role of ucOCN in aerobic exercise induced amelioration of autism spectrum disorder phenotypes
pmc-13378376.creator: Yaxin Shi, Tikang Zhu, Shuting Wang, Yao Sun, Yutong Liu, Shuangshuang Chen, Wanying Qiao, Ding Zhou, Zuyue Wang, Lili Fan, Hongmei Wu
pmc-13378376.description: SummaryAutism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a severe neurodevelopmental disorder closely associated with synaptic dysfunction that contributes to core behavioral deficits. Aerobic exercise (AE) serves as a promising adjuvant intervention for diverse neuropsychiatric conditions, and accumulating evidence suggests favorable effects of AE on ASD-related behaviors and physiological traits.

pmc-13391276.title: AI-enabled instructor care and physical fitness performance in police cadets: the mediating roles of emotions, engagement, and recovery
pmc-13391276.creator: Zeyu Zhang, Mahpiret Kanji, Xiaomei Lu
pmc-13391276.description: BackgroundPolice training is physically demanding and psychologically stressful, which may undermine training adaptation and physical performance. Artificial intelligence (AI)-supported learning analytics systems have been proposed as scalable tools to support training management, yet empirical evidence remains limited regarding how such systems may operate when embedded in human instructor care practices.

pmc-13401122.title: Compartment-Specific Associations of GDF15 With Intraocular Cytokines in Patients With Idiopathic Epiretinal Membrane
pmc-13401122.creator: Hiroki Mieno, Masatsugu Hashida, Kengo Yoshii, Munetoyo Toda, Tomoko Horikiri, Kimiaki Urabe, Kazuhiko Mori, Morio Ueno, Chie Sotozono
pmc-13401122.description: PurposeThe purpose of this study was to characterize the intraocular cytokine context of growth differentiation factor 15 (GDF15), a stress-response cytokine implicated in tissue injury and immune regulation, in eyes with idiopathic epiretinal membrane (iERM) by evaluating paired aqueous humor (AH) and vitreous humor (VH) samples and their compartment-specific associations with other soluble cytokines.

pmc-13524458.title: Durability Analysis of a Self-Expanding Transcatheter Aortic Valve Through 30 Years of Accelerated Wear Testing
pmc-13524458.creator: Guilherme Attizzani, Marco Frazzetto, Ole De Backer, Danny Dvir, Vanessa Garlepp, Tim Kelley, Kendra J. Grubb, Gilbert H.L. Tang
pmc-13524458.description: Highlights•First reported 30-year in vitro accelerated wear testing data for a THV.•All Evolut PRO + valves met ISO hydrodynamic criteria through 20 years of testing.•At least one valve per size maintained performance through 30 years of testing.•Failures manifested in a consistent pattern, suggesting a shared mechanism.•Testing is ongoing until all valves fail.

pmc-13622901.title: Investigation of Misleading Techniques Used in Online Fluoride Misinformation
pmc-13622901.creator: Matheus Lotto, Caio Sampaio, Olívia Santana Jorge, Juliano Pelim Pessan, Thiago Cruvinel
pmc-13622901.description: ObjectivesFluoride misinformation can fuel anti‐fluoridation movements, influencing political decisions and dental treatment choices. This study aimed to elucidate the misleading techniques used to produce online fluoride misinformation.MethodologyTwo independent investigators searched scientific databases for references that supported or refuted 33 fluoride misinformation messages, derived from a prior study that manually identified dental falsehoods on websites through thematic content analysis.
